name: Mausam Mitra AI Contract
purpose: Standard contract between Vaayu AI and the backend/service registry.
principle: AI understands and routes requests; it is not the authoritative weather-data source.

output.persona: health_conscious | fitness | beachgoers_surfers | travellers | parents_families | agriculture_gardeners | commuters | event_planners | unknown
output.intent: current_weather | weather_forecast | rainfall_forecast | temperature | wind | air_quality | weather_alert | travel_weather | navigation | general_weather | unknown

rules: Do not treat the LLM's internal knowledge as current weather data.
Use trusted backend data or existing Mausam services for weather facts.
Ask for missing location/date/time information when it is required.
Use the selected persona as context, but do not force an unrelated intent.
If the correct Mausam service cannot be identified, ask a clarification question or provide a safe fallback.
Keep the contract stable between frontend, AI, and backend.
